entities.name: Ethyl ester hydrolysis
observations: The encoded reactant contains an ethyl ester, CCOC(=O), while the product contains the corresponding carboxylic acid, C(=O)O.
The principal transformation is ester hydrolysis/saponification; the scaffold and dichloropyridinyl amide remain unchanged.
No new ring-forming event or oxidation is required; apparent ring differences arise from alternate tokenized representations.

entities.name: NaOH MeOH H2O HCl
observations: A directly matching record uses aqueous sodium hydroxide in methanol, followed by hydrochloric acid workup, to convert the ethyl ester into the carboxylic acid.
